report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200; three of four were 62-78ms and one was 344ms. Traces show a single slow request dominated by the order call (~322ms) with healthy downstream spans and no errors. Metrics show 0 502s and no dependency failures. No evidence establishes a fault; the lone latency spike is insufficient to substantiate any taxonomy cause, so hand off for baseline comparison.
missing_evidence: Baseline latency distribution for /v1/checkout to determine whether 344ms is anomalous
Downstream service latency metrics (order, payment, inventory) to attribute the single slow request
Error-rate or saturation metrics for order/payment/inventory over the alert window
